question.text: During the AGM of a public company conducted via Video Conferencing, which communication facility must be provided to shareholders?

answer.text: One-way video streaming only, with questions submitted via email afterwards
Pre-recorded video messages from the Board of Directors
Audio-only conferencing without any video component
Two-way teleconferencing or webex facility for real-time interaction

explanation.text: The Logic: For an electronic AGM, the workbook requires a two-way teleconferencing or webex facility for shareholders. Members may either submit questions in advance or ask questions concurrently during the meeting, and the facility must have a capacity for at least 1000 members. The Trap: A one-way broadcast, pre-recorded videos or audio-only conferencing would not satisfy the two-way teleconferencing/webex requirement, even though they look like reasonable virtual-meeting formats. Note: The two-way teleconferencing/webex facility, the concurrent or advance-question option and the at-least-1000 members capacity requirement are set out on page 160 of the NISM-Series-II-A Registrars and Transfer Agents (Corporate) Certification Examination workbook (October 2025).
